name: Heave Offering
overview: The Heave Offering, as described in Scripture, is a sacred portion set apart for the Lord and His priests, involving the first fruits and best of the gifts brought to God's house. It includes specific parts of peace offerings, such as the right shoulder, and is to be heaved up by the priest in a clean place, signifying sanctification of the whole offering. The offering extends to the first dough of the bread of the land and a tenth of all tithes, emphasizing the dedication of all blessings back to God as commanded in the law.
